snippet.title: Reel Greed trailer - Wishlist on Steam!
snippet.description:
🎰 REEL GREED is a casino incremental game built around massive jackpots, chaotic upgrades, and satisfying progression.

Spin the reels, trigger huge payouts, unlock powerful upgrades, and flood the screen with mountains of money as your build grows stronger and more absurd.

💰 Features:
• Fast-paced slot machine gameplay
• Tons of upgrades and synergies
• Card choices and powerful modifiers
• Huge money explosions and satisfying progression
• Endless jackpot chasing
